title: Sources config for one source repo (config/<source-repo>/sources.json)

url.description: Public, anonymous URL. Private repos are never sources.

start.description: Which refs are published. Tags and branch heads whose commit is `tag`'s or descends from it, prereleases included; with `releasesFrom`, also every release tag (a semver version with no prerelease part) at or above that version, wherever its commit is. Branch heads must descend from `tag`.

releasesFrom.description: Lowest release backfilled. To go further back, lower it, after checking that a build profile covers the newly included tags and that contractRoles lists their proxies.

branches.description: Branches whose heads are built (never their earlier commits). Patterns; '*' matches anything including '/'. Order sets which branch new code is attributed to (the entry's ref) when several new heads produce it.

contractRoles.description: Proxies and proxy admins, by fully qualified name; every other contract is logic. Copied into each entry (role, implementationSlots) when it is written, so list a contract before its first build is published. Contracts sharing a fingerprint must have the same role.

reviewedRangePairs.description: Pairs of entries with the same code length that mask different bytes, each reviewed by rebuilding both and confirming that their code differs at some byte neither masks, so no code can match both. Every other such pair fails publish and CI, which keeps lookups to at most one match.

fingerprints.description: The two entries, in either order

note.description: What the review found, and who reviewed it

when.description: Commits the test-chain check applies to; every commit when absent. Commits due a check outside it are built and published without the check, and each run reports them in checksSkipped.
Commits this profile builds; the first matching profile wins.

refSelector.description: Selects source commits. Every condition given must hold; an empty selector matches every commit.

descendantOf.description: The commit is each of these refs or descends from it

notDescendantOf.description: The commit is none of these refs and descends from none of them

refs.description: The commit is what one of these refs points at

tags.description: A published tag pointing at the commit is a semver version with from <= version < before, by semver precedence (so v3.2.0-beta.0 is before v3.2.0). A commit no published tag points at never matches.
